title: Job
description: Employment opportunity or job posting published by companies. Contains position details, requirements, compensation information, location, employment type, and posting validity dates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the job posting

title.description: Job title or position name (e.g., Senior Software Engineer, Marketing Manager)

company.description: Name of the company or organization offering the position

description.description: Detailed description of the role, responsibilities, and what the position entails

requirements.description: Required qualifications, skills, experience, and education needed for the position

location.description: City or office location where the job is based

country.description: Country where the job position is located

type.description: Employment type (e.g., full-time, part-time, contract, internship, freelance)

level.description: Experience level required (e.g., entry-level, mid-level, senior, executive)

salary_min.description: Minimum annual salary offered for the position

salary_max.description: Maximum annual salary offered for the position

currency.description: ISO currency code for the salary range (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

remote.description: Whether the position allows remote work or work-from-home options

posted_at.description: Timestamp when the job posting was published

expires_at.description: Date and time when the job posting expires and applications are no longer accepted
